title: Real-time lead pipeline
summary: Leads from Meta Lead Ads and Google APIs reach the CRM through webhooks as they happen, instead of in delayed batches.
points: Webhook endpoints receive lead events from the ad platforms
Leads are processed into the CRM pipeline in real time
The sales team works from the same system of record

diagram.caption: Lead events flow from ad platforms into the CRM

title: Payment-receipt allocation engine
summary: Incoming payment receipts are allocated FIFO across a booking's milestones. Row-level locking makes sure the same receipt can never be allocated twice.
outcome: No double allocation under concurrent writes
points: FIFO allocation fills the oldest outstanding milestone first
SELECT … FOR UPDATE locks the rows inside the transaction
cron jobs send payment reminders and bank-specific demand notes

diagram.caption: Illustrative example: one receipt allocated across milestones, oldest first

snippet.title: Simplified pattern

title: Exotel VoIP calling service
summary: A calling microservice gives the sales team in-app calling. Calls are routed to the lead's owner, with round-robin as the fallback.
outcome: In-app calling for the sales team
points: Webhook handlers process Exotel call events
Owner-aware routing sends a call to the agent who owns the lead
Round-robin fallback when no owner can take the call

title: Document automation with Microsoft Graph
summary: Booking and legal documents are generated as Word files through Microsoft Graph and stored as versioned PDFs in OneDrive.
outcome: Automated booking and legal document workflows
points: Word documents generated from workflow data via Microsoft Graph
PDFs stored in OneDrive with versioning
Powers booking, e-stamp and legal file request workflows

diagram.caption: From workflow event to versioned PDF

title: Read-path performance
summary: Redis caching on high-traffic CRM endpoints, plus rewriting N+1 query patterns as single queries using ROW_NUMBER() window functions.
points: Hot endpoints are served from Redis
N+1 loops replaced by single queries using ROW_NUMBER()
Lower database load on the busiest CRM screens
